sampling.method: Rank every stock in the population by sha256("<seed>:<symbol>") and keep the round(10%) lowest
sampling.population_rule: A shares (codes 00xxxx and 30xxxx) with at least one exchange quote snapshot on any trading day of the release range; stocks delisted or newly listed during the range are included

availability_rule: Each row is a 15-second boundary (available_at) inside a regular trading session; its values are the latest exchange snapshot stamped at or before that boundary within the same session of the same day. Nothing is carried across sessions or overnight. source_event_time is never later than available_at.
null_convention: An empty book level is null in both its price and volume columns

flags.missing_depth: true when the best bid or the best ask (level 1) is empty
flags.stale: true when the snapshot is more than 15 seconds older than available_at
